rows: I wish to request access to the following records under the Freedom of Information Act: i) Records of deer culls in Phoenix Park during 2016 and 2017, to include the date of the cull, the number and type of deer culled, revenue generated through the sale of carcasses from each cull, the purchaser of the carcasses, and the name of the sniper(s) engaged to carry out each cull. ii) Records of the current stock of deer in Phoenix Park, and the stock of deer in Phoenix Park at the beginning of 2016. iii) Records relating to deer that died in road accidents or in other circumstances during 2016 and 2017. iv) The total amount paid to snipers for carrying out deer culls in Phoenix Park during 2016 and 2017 - a cumulative figure in order to negate any concerns regarding commercial sensitivity. v) The total amount paid to snipers for carrying out deer culls in Phoenix Park since 2013.

Please provide information regarding any articles - including paintings, monuments, sculptures, etc - that are either the property of the OPW or managed/monitored by the OPW on behalf of the state, that have, in 2017, been: -damaged, or; -gone missing for any period of time. Please provide information regarding any cost accrued in the repair or relocation of these items; please provide information regarding how they came to be damaged/lost in the first instance and any delays in notification of same; and please provide any information regarding any items that are still missing at the time of this request and the value of same. If there is any further information regarding any sanctions applied to individuals or departments/bodies etc regarding the above, please also include this as part of this request, as well as any related documentation.
